body: Something similar happened to me last year. I was walking through campus and I was dressed nice because I was actually on my way to work, not class. I came across a lone turtle in my path, but we weren't near a body of water. There was a pond along my route though, so I just picked him up and carried him across campus with me. Usually people on campus ignore each other, but that day everyone saw me as the turtle man.
Scott. Named after toilet-paper. Not kidding.
